events.title: UEFA gives FIFA president Gianni Infantino an ultimatum to resign or face an emergency no-confidence vote following Infantino's plan to sell stakes in FIFA Forward Enterprise , which he has rescinded amidst backlash. (BBC Sport) ( The Telegraph )

Major League Soccer , the top flight of men's soccer in the U.S. and Canada , announces that Larry Berg , currently a co-owner of 로스앤젤레스 FC (LAFC) in that league, will succeed Don Garber as league commissioner at the start of 2027. Berg will sell his interest in LAFC before assuming his new position. (AP) ( The Guardian )
The Ukrainian Premier League 's FC Chornomorets Odesa announces on Telegram that its match against FC Kolos Kovalivka is postponed after its home stadium was hit by a Russian strike. (Intent)
Mexico defeats the United States 2–0 at the Estadio Azteca to win the CONCACAF Under-20 Championship , its second in a row after winning the previous one . (ESPN)

In association football , Malawi 's women's national football team defeats Ghana 2–1 at the Women's Africa Cup of Nations in the quarter-finals at Al Medina Stadium in Morocco , qualifying for the upcoming FIFA Women's World Cup in Brazil and will make their debut at the tournament. ( Nyasa Times ) (Ghanaweb) (ESPN)

In flag football , Canada 's women's team defeats the defending champion United States to win its third IFAF Flag Football World Championship title. Additionally, the men's football team qualifies for the upcoming Summer Olympics . (Global News)

In association football , Johor Darul Ta'zim claims a world record for the longest unbeaten run in top-flight league play, reaching 109 matches after defeating Kuching City 3–0 in Malaysia 's Super League . (AFP via RFI)
